newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Wing Teik owns 75 pct of Philippines NSC.
newsitem.headline: Wing Teik owns 75 pct of Philippines NSC.

text.p: Malaysia's Wing Teik Holdings Bhd is now official owner of a 75 percent stake in National Steel Corp (NSC) after its full payment of 12.2 billion pesos to the Philippine government, National Development Co (NDC) general manager Arthur Aguilar said on Friday.
The national Bernama news agency quoted him as saying in a Manila-datelined report that the sale of the NSC stake helped to reduce debts incurred in funding the Philippine steel firm.
Government firm NDC sold the stake to Wing Teik under a privisation plan of the steel concern.
NDC holds the remaining 25 percent stake in NSC but plans to sell it to Wing Teik after it failed to attract buyers in an Oct 2 public bidding, Bernama said.

Wing Teik group managing director Joseph Chong said last month a fresh capital infusion of US$135 million in NSC by end-October would contribute to the completion of expansion plans and enhance the company's financial capabilities by next year.

Shares of Wing Teik and two other companies controlled by Chong -- Westmont Industries Bhd and Westmont Land (Asia) Bhd were suspended from trading in Kuala Lumpur on Friday pending a news announcement.
But it was not clear if the suspensions were related to the NSC news.
